# Jihed Ben Arfa - Full Index

> Production-grade engineering knowledge, executable labs and reusable Spring libraries for Java architects: distributed systems, Keycloak security, BPMN orchestration, telecom provisioning and enterprise AI engineering.

## Repositories

### engineering-library
- **URL**: https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/engineering-library
- **Description**: Production-grade Java 17 / Spring Boot 3 monorepo featuring 90+ multi-tiered reference implementations (nano to macro), 13 knowledge domains, ADRs, and post-mortem analysis.
- **Tech Stack**: Java 17+, Spring Boot 3, Spring Cloud
- **Index**: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jihedbfr-art/engineering-library/main/README.md

### bpmn-provisioning-patterns
- **URL**: https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/bpmn-provisioning-patterns
- **Description**: Executable Camunda + Spring Boot + Kafka Sagas modeling telecom provisioning, multi-operator number portability with SLA timeouts, and threshold-based batch compensation.
- **Tech Stack**: Camunda BPMN, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Testcontainers, OpenTelemetry
- **Index**: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jihedbfr-art/bpmn-provisioning-patterns/main/README.md

### keycloak-spi-workbench
- **URL**: https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/keycloak-spi-workbench
- **Description**: Real-world Keycloak SPI extensions (Custom Authenticators, Event Listeners, Federation) built properly with full integration test coverage.
- **Tech Stack**: Java, Keycloak SPI
- **Index**: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jihedbfr-art/keycloak-spi-workbench/main/README.md

### spring-keycloak-toolkit
- **URL**: https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/spring-keycloak-toolkit
- **Description**: Enterprise Spring Boot auto-configuration library for Keycloak OAuth2/OIDC Resource Servers, solving role-mapping and RFC 7807 problem details.
- **Tech Stack**: Spring Boot, Keycloak, OAuth2/OIDC
- **Index**: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jihedbfr-art/spring-keycloak-toolkit/main/README.md

### ai-skills
- **URL**: https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/ai-skills
- **Description**: Pragmatic AI Engineering Knowledge Base (LLM Economics, Hybrid RAG, Multi-Agent Orchestration, MCP Protocol, Spring AI & Guardrails) powered by JihedAiLabs.
- **Tech Stack**: Spring AI, LLMs, MCP
- **Index**: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jihedbfr-art/ai-skills/main/README.md

### cyber-skills
- **URL**: https://github.com/jihedbfr-art/cyber-skills
- **Description**: A working library of security skills across 26 domains — each an agent-ready SKILL.md that doubles as a human cheatsheet. Bilingual EN/FR.
- **Tech Stack**: Cybersecurity, Agent Skills
- **Index**: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jihedbfr-art/cyber-skills/main/README.md
